info: Flame Pokémon. Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
Shellfish Pokémon. A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.
Seed Pokémon. This plant blooms when it absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
Mouse Pokémon. When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.
Genetic Pokémon. A Pokémon created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering.
Superpower Pokémon. Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
Atrocious Pokémon. Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
Psi Pokémon. Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
Sleeping Pokémon. Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its belly bulges, it becomes progressively more lethargic.
Lightning Pokémon. It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast 10,000-volt lightning bolts.
Bubble Jet Pokémon. Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
Flame Pokémon. When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature can soar to over 1,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Shadow Pokémon. Under a full moon, if shadows start to move and laugh, it is acting on Gengar's behalf.
Dragon Pokémon. An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
Electric Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
Flame Pokémon. Seemingly possessed by evil energy, its fiery breath is dark and scorching hot.
Mouse Pokémon. Extremely aggressive and quick-tempered when manipulated by Team Rocket handlers.
Diving Pokémon. It is said that it quietens raging seas. It causes 40-day storms merely by flapping its wings.
Volcano Pokémon. If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
Sky High Pokémon. It flies endlessly through the ozone layer. It feeds on water and particles in the atmosphere.
Moonlight Pokémon. When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow and a mysterious energy awakens.
Flame Pokémon. Powerful Tera ex card capable of burning down any opponent with high damage Output.
Psi Pokémon. Uses dimensional attacks from the bench to overwhelm opposing Pokémon.
New Species Pokémon. A Pokémon of miraculous rarity. It is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon.
Legendary Pokémon. A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully as if on wings.
Gas Pokémon. Because of its ability to slip through solid walls, it is said to be from another dimension.
Mouse Pokémon. Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
Fox Pokémon. Very smart and very vindictive. Grabbing one of its 9 tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
Transport Pokémon. A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across water.
Fossil Pokémon. A ferocious, prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated teeth.
Flame Pokémon. Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
Scissors Pokémon. It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to intimidate its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
Dragon Pokémon. It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
Shellfish Pokémon. An aggressive Pokémon that uses high pressure water cannons to smash through steel walls.
Dragon Pokémon. Seemingly ruthless, it flies at Mach 2 speeds over oceans seeking targets.
Intertwining Pokémon. It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its beloved Trainer's arm as they walk together.
Shadow Pokémon. It swallows everything around it, expanding its mouth into a cavern of endless dark energy.
Embrace Pokémon. It will unleash its psychokinetic power at full force to protect a Trainer it trusts.
Seed Pokémon. A large flower blooms on Venusaur's back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of sunlight.
Shellfish Pokémon. It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
Parent Pokémon. The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.
Stagbeetle Pokémon. If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.
Dragon Pokémon. A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Said to have the ability to change weather conditions.
Lizard Pokémon. Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
Flame Pokémon. When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to insanely high levels.
Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
Turtle Pokémon. Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
Seed Pokémon. A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
Seed Pokémon. When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
Bird Pokémon. When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
Armor Pokémon. If it rages, it knocks down mountains and fills up rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
Big Jaw Pokémon. It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick legs.
Herb Pokémon. The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
Tiny Mouse Pokémon. It is still unskilled at storing electricity. It may discharge if startled.
Hermit Crab Pokémon. An attached Shellder lives on Slowbro's tail. As a result, Slowbro can no longer fish with it.
Sludge Pokémon. Thickly covered with toxic slime. It leaves behind poison footprints wherever it moves.
Kicking Pokémon. When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long strides.
Atrocious Pokémon. Normally found in deep sea caverns, Team Rocket captured and enraged it.
Psi Pokémon. Its brain cells multiply until human memory fails to measure its psychic capacity.
Superpower Pokémon. Uses four arms to grab and strike targets with unmatched aggression.
Bubble Jet Pokémon. Corrupted by dark energy, its water jet attack dissolves solid obstacles.
Lightning Pokémon. Emits intense lightning bolts that crackle around its dark fur.
Flame Pokémon. Flushes intense thermal heat to burn opponent Pokémon to ashes.
Dragon Pokémon. Uses VSTAR Power to rain down meteors across the battle field.
Aura Pokémon. By sensing the aura of all things, it can determine feelings and movements.
Superpower Pokémon. Dynamax power inflates its four arms to crushing proportions.
Sleeping Pokémon. Powerful ex card that absorbs damage while sleeping peacefully.
Freeze Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
Lonely Pokémon. Wears the skull of its deceased mother. It cries mournfully at the full moon.
Bone Keeper Pokémon. Small and weak, it took to using bones to overcome its natural frailty.
Fairy Pokémon. A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It runs and hides the instant it senses people.
Electric Pokémon. Normally found near power plants, they can cause major blackouts if they wander into cities.
Egg Pokémon. A rare and gentle Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs with injured people.
